method: Codex read each full Chinese source and all three translations, corrected findings, and compared semantic and technical boundaries.

checks.coverage_and_meaning: 四语完整覆盖YAML、验证/解释、预览/生成、生成工程验证和六项常见错误，明确SRM传递引入Workflow但不引入采购资产。
checks.technical_literals: YAML五个模块及id/version结构一致；容器CLI相对路径、Nacos完整变量/Base64要求、JWK32字符与Docker构建命令准确。 本次再审将XXL_JOB_ADMIN_USERNAME/XXL_JOB_ADMIN_PASSWORD与实际.env.example和Compose逐项核对，四语一致。
checks.security_and_failure_semantics: 不复用共享密钥、不共用数据卷、不覆盖源根或非空输出、先dry-run、MQ缺SRM悬空消费者保护及可选开关边界都保留。
checks.language_and_terminology: English accurately separates source validation from generated-project verification; root itself clarification matches validateTarget rather than rejecting all nested output.
checks.images_and_links: 没有图片或实际Markdown链接；当前规范YAML和generated/supplier-app路径能在工具容器内读取，生成后命令使用该工程自己的Compose。
